text: [photo: loading bay]
Which one is that, lane 4?
Yeah. Jack left across it, pallets stacked on the side
Was it the 5am crew?
Looks like it. Didnt see who
not me this time 😅
Nobody said it was you
ok
Going to bed. If the jack is still there tonight tell me and ill sort it
Up. Jack's still there, moved it to the wall myself
Not sure it helps, somebody else will leave it again
just woke up. who's on the 6am van tonight, it still me?
Think so. Check the sheet
checked, yes
also need to swap thursday for a bit if anyone can take the morning run. my cousin's thing is at 10
I can do the morning run sat, not thu
ok thanks, i'll ask the others for thu
Woke up at 15:30 and forgot to say, lane 4 is clear now?
Clear. Pallets are gone too
Good
on the road to the depot now, first drop is in 20 min
[photo: rear bumper of the van]
clipped the bollard at the depot gate. its fine, only the bumper
Saw it. Log it on the sheet or they'll blame the 5am crew
logged it
Still on for the 9am run. Keys are in the box?
keys in the box. spare is in my locker if u need it
Run done. One drop refused, customer wasn't in, left the card at the desk
Up. Thu morning run, is it still open? I can take it
just woke. yeah still open. thanks man 🙏
Ok, putting my name on the sheet
Someone parked a drum in lane 4 again. Who's on the early side tonight?
Not me
not me this time 😅
heading out for the first drop
On site. Lane 4 is clear, I checked at start of shift
Forgot to ask, Théo did the bumper get sorted
yeah, form filed. dont want anyone thinking its the 5am crew
Up. Drum's gone from lane 4, someone moved it to the cage
Don't know who. Not you two I assume
Up. Not me
Thu run, what time is pickup on the sheet
6:30 from the depot
Ok
just woke. thanks for moving the drum karine
not on the van tonight, sunday off. anyone seen the handheld? not on the hook
Charging bay. Somebody left it there Thursday
found it
Going to the Leclerc. Anyone need anything
No, I'm good
Shift starts at 22. East side parking is full again
[photo: parking lot]
bakery truck blocking the east side again 🙄
Heading in
Lane 4 is clear. Checked at start
Thu keys are in the box, right? I'll grab them Wed night
ok
Warning light on the Thu van. Log it or the 5am crew gets blamed again
logged it. not me this time 😅
